title: Food Alert For Action: To food businesses and consumers who have purchased shell eggs originating from Yasensvit Ltd, Ukraine, stamped with the code 3UA1012066
product: The establishment: Yasensvit Ltd, Kyiv, Ukraine; Raw shell-on eggs - Product Code 3UA1012066
reason:
The possible presence of Salmonella in the product listed above. Symptoms caused by Salmonella usually include fever, diarrhoea and abdominal cramps. If you are experiencing these symptoms, you should stay away from work, school or nursery until you have stopped having symptoms for at least 48 hours to avoid passing it on to others.

Advice for businesses:
Food businesses should check their egg supply chain and the codes stamped on eggs within their control. It is possible eggs with this code originating from Yasensvit Ltd, Kyiv, Ukraine, may have been repacked by other businesses in the UK and have different business details and packing centre codes detailed on the outer packaging. Businesses are advised to immediately stop using or selling eggs with the stamp 3UA1012066, undertake product withdrawals, and where there have been retail sales, to undertake product recalls. If you have been supplied with these eggs, dispose of them safely. These eggs should not be diverted to further processing.
